name: Eyes on Yuki
detailed_description:
You are trying to save a magical world. Yuki’s trying to hug a beehive. 

Eyes on Yuki is a chaotic couch co-op tower defense where your mission is simple: protect the statues from enemies and bring color back to the world. The key to it? Yuki. The obstacle? Also Yuki.

See, Yuki powers the statues with its… whatever it’s special for and the statues bring color back to the world. Easy.

And you players must...

*pulls out a list. puts on glasses. clears throat.*

See... Collect defenses, create resources, protect the enemies from statues and keep Yuki from chasing fireflies, falling asleep, or getting kidnapped by a suspicious goose. Again. Did I got it right? I feel like I didn't.

It can be a little overwhelming at times, but that's why there's two of you!

Besides, what's teamwork without a little bit of chaos? You'll manage just fine.

🎮 Good Ol' Couch Co-Op

Remember the days when playing together meant squeezing onto the same couch, throwing insults, and stealing the last slice of pizza? Eyes on Yuki brings back that magic.

Grab your best bud and prepare for the kind of local co-op mayhem you forgot you were missing.

🛡️ Is this a Tower Defense?

You’ll gather resources, exploit a cute little family of moles to build turrets and defend statues. So yeah.

🌿 Gather Resources

  • Carry sap and shiny magic metals across the map. Some materials need two players—teamwork or tantrums, your choice.

🔨 Build Turrets

  • Whack the helmeted little moles to create turrets. Simple. You've seen it before. Slightly ridiculous. Highly effective.

🗿 Defend the Statues

  • Protect the frog-ish moais as they purify the world. No pressure. Just the fate of everything.

🐸 Do I have to babysit a frog?

Meet Yuki: a magical creature with the attention span of a soggy crouton. Yet somehow, he’s the only one who can purify the statues and bring the color back to the world.

But staying near the statues? Not exactly his strong suit. He’ll wander off. He’ll get distracted by whatever catches his nonexistent focus. And sometimes, a suspicious goose decides to kidnap him. Don’t ask why. Just go get him back.

🎨 A Whimsical World in Living Color

The world of Eyes on Yuki is a patchwork of cozy landscapes and questionable logic. From curious critters to statues waiting to bloom, everything feels a little bit handmade—and a little bit unhinged.

As you purify each statue, vibrant colors flood back into the environment, transforming faded grays into bright, stylized beauty. Because saving the world should look (and feel) absolutely delightful—even if it doesn’t always makes sense.

short_description: Think you can babysit a magical little frog with the IQ of a toaster and the chaotic energy of a squirrel on five espressos? Meet Yuki: an adorable creature who is both the reason and the solution to this mess. Grab your best bud, keep your eyes on Yuki and bring color back to the world!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1024 VRAM); Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2048 VRAM); Radeon R9 380 (2048 VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
